address: 241-243 Nguyen Trai Street, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71014, Vietnam
bio: This venue may not offer much in terms of ambience, but can’t be beaten for tasty beef noodles at affordable prices. Besides the usual raw beef, or medium-rare brisket, their springy and flavoursome beef balls are also a must. If you can’t make up your mind, order the house special with everything in the bowl. Meat lovers can also add extra cuts of beef to the pho. A bowl piled high with meat is thoroughly satisfying.
